filingWindows.uninsuredClaims: For an Uninsured Asbestos Claim that satisfies the TDP's tolling conditions and was not already barred, the TDP treats the claim as timely if filed within three years after the six-month anniversary of the Initial Claims Filing Date. estimatedResidual.basis: No public inception-to-date payment figure exists for these trusts (DCPF-administered trusts report only to PACER). Allowance derived from: (1) system payout run-rate ~$1.5-2B/yr documented by Bates White/Mealey's ($14.0B paid 2006-2011) and RAND (~$3.3B in 2008) less the itemized components' share; (2) these trusts' combined documented balances (~$4B, corpus 1.1.2) vs combined initial funding, implying several billion paid to date; (3) corpus assessment that 2026 system-wide cumulative payments are 'plausibly $30B+'. Filed FY2024-FY2025 partial-year payments for Flintkote ($79,936,659) and B&W ($19,890,000) are conservatively treated inside this allowance and the B&W floor respectively.

bottomUpPayouts.methodology: Bottom-up sum replacing the round $24,000,000,000 point estimate. Tier 1: filed inception-to-date figures (14 trusts, as-of dates 2006-2026). Tier 2: secondary compilations citing filed annual reports (5 components), used only where no filed figure exists, each labeled. Tier 3: explicit allowance for ~25 trusts with no public cumulative figure, with stated range ($2.5-5B). The total is non-round because every component is a traceable number; it leans conservative because several Tier 1/2 as-of dates are stale (payments since those dates are only partly captured) and the B&W figure is a stated floor.
